overview.about: The Baycurrent Classic is the PGA Tour's stop in Japan, bringing elite American-tour golf to a passionate Japanese audience. Played on a Tom Watson-designed layout near Tokyo, it continues the Tour's push into one of the world's biggest golf markets.
overview.nextEvent: The next Baycurrent Classic is played on the Tom Watson Golf Course in Ibaraki, Japan. As the Tour's lone Japanese event, it draws big galleries and a strong international field.
